query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T07:45:35.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T07:48:37.065Z"
        AND host.name == "canary-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
        sample_message = MAX(message)
        BY source.ip, user.name, message
| SORT failed_count DESC
| LIMIT 10
